services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Four Mile Historic Park is a great resource for educators and students when learning about Colorado’s rich history. Whether it is through a field trip experience at the Park or a traveling trunk in your classroom, Four Mile’s special programming dives into the subjects of cultural history, natural history, and more! Come learn about the multitude of insects that call Four Mile home, including the oversized temporary residents of this year’s Bright Nights installation! Attendees will get up close (behind glass) with our resident bees, create paper tube binoculars, learn about Colorado’s pollinators, and much more! Choose your own adventure! services.name: Birthday Parties
services.desc: Located in the heart of the city, Four Mile’s 12-acre site provides a rustic landscape where children can travel back in time to Colorado in the 1800s. A costumed Four Mile Historic Park staff member leads the birthday guests and scout groups through their chosen activities, and parents are encouraged to join in on the fun. Experience one-room schoolhouse lessons, participate in daily farm chores, cook over an open fire, view objects related to Denver’s early history, explore the Four Mile House Museum, visit with the Park’s critters, or make butter.
